notes: Fifth-generation family ranch in southeast Kansas; town McCune comes from the company's own McCune Farm to Market store on the retail locations page (about page names no town). Found via a web search result for shopkansasfarms.com (From the Land of Kansas). Read homepage, about, freezer beef product, lamb and poultry collections and retail locations (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote; ground beef page failed). About page: animals graze several hundred acres of prairie and specialty grasses, native grass hay in winter, minerals. Pork described as raised outdoors, poultry as free-range and pastured; no grass-only claim for lamb beyond 'grass fed' in page titles. Site also uses the word organic in titles, but no certification checked or added. Meta description says they ship nationwide; no state list or rules found. Retail locations: Overland Park and Lenexa farmers markets, Market Wagon (KC, Wichita, St. Louis), Shatto Home Delivery, Next to Nature Farm Store in Leavenworth, own store in McCune. Also sells pecans, pies and a veggie box; not confirmed whether grown on the farm, so not listed as products. Freezer beef share says sold out until late February 2027, so the availability note applies to bulk only; Verifier may drop availability if cuts are in stock.
